ideas.pitch: An anti-money laundering and risk detection dashboard tailored for regional cooperative banks, integrating graph intelligence to spot simulated quantum-resistant transaction laundering patterns.
ideas.title: QuantumLedger AML
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses the Quantum FinTech track by applying advanced graph intelligence to financial crime, similar to how Bito won by building AML risk detection platforms.

ideas.pitch: A mobile-first offline-first asset and consumables tracking tool for local panchayats to monitor public utility infrastructure and welfare funds transparently.
ideas.title: GramAsset Manager
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the success of JalSetu at the Smart India Hackathon by solving local public administration and social welfare delivery bottlenecks directly relevant to regional judges.

ideas.pitch: A multilingual voice-first health awareness application that provides rural citizens with localized vaccine schedules and immediate symptom guidance during local disease outbreaks.
ideas.title: ArogyaSetu Mobile AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning blueprint of SAGACITY by targeting rural health literacy and preventive care, a high-impact social welfare problem.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent platform that coordinates community volunteers to group and transport nearby senior citizens to essential medical and social outings.
ideas.title: CivicRide Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the Grand Prize-winning Outreach model to solve a clear public-safety and social welfare coordination challenge with measurable community benefit.

ideas.pitch: A Poisson regression and probabilistic forecasting tool designed to predict financial liquidity stress events and micro-economic market shocks for student fintech startups.
ideas.title: QuantRisk Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines rigorous statistical forecasting with fintech use cases, echoing the winning predictive modeling approach seen in the Apart Research AI Forecasting Hackathon.
